reviews.review_description:
Some guy named “foreverbloxian” joined my lobby and started shouting really rude and hurtful things at little children as young as the age of 4. This is unacceptable and I demand justice to be served for his behavior. I will be taking legal action soon.
Aha Ok

Update: I have spotted another admin that goes by the name “TheRealRondax” doing similar things but much worse. Going as far as to permanently ban little children for having too much fun in the game right after bullying them. This extreme cyberbullying must come to a halt immediately. And if it doesn’t, I might just have to step in.

Update 2: This is outrageeous. A developer for the game that goes by the name “Roasty31” has also been spotted harassing and verbally abusing innocent children who just want to play gorilla tag horror remastered. Words cannot describe how speechless i am that a game like this where toxicity and abuse is normalized is still on the Meta Quest store. I demand action to be taken against this and  I will not only be taking this to court but also will  be contacting my local authorities about this. Bismillah

My son loved this game, he has been playing since December 2025. I like seeing him have fun. However, with the new update, I notice that he is seeming a lot less more happy. People are cussing in his games, and I do not tolerate this! Add moderation ASAP, because I do not like seeing my boy upset while playing this game. If an update isn’t added, I’m refunding all 20.00$ of my transactions to this game. Outrageous!
Also, when my son saw a moderator, they walked up to him and said “Burger pots #####!”. I am not tolerating this. And if you refuse to add moderation, I will also be taking legal action.
